notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures that share a creature type.
description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
